scope: Design baseline before ADR-135 runtime implementation; deterministic local bridges/controllers and real SQLite, scripted provider and MCP transport, no live provider.
limitations: Holding a gate for 350 ms measures only a latency lower bound; an unreleased sibling or approval can hold the current barrier indefinitely.
The failed-stamp probe exercises durable-state reconstruction through seed_from_marks in the same process; it is not a killed-process or power-loss test.
Two provider calls demonstrate replayed automatic work, not a measured duplicate external tool side effect.
These opt-in probes report behavior; they do not pin the old policy as a desired regression contract.
